Entities of TRANSFER atoms are TRANSFER_DESTINATION by construction and are correctly not penalized. 4_role_conflict.rule: ROLE_CONFLICT (same folded name labelled ROUTE_LEG and ITINERARY_STOP in one segment) on any criterion 1-3 entity: at most 1 occurrence across all valid SOB+AG runs. All ROLE_CONFLICTs are reported. A conflicted entity stays mandatory, so it never counts as success for criteria 1-3.

5_recall.rule: Over valid SOB+AG runs, oracle-mandatory items present in their owning segment >= 99% (at most 1 missing item in total), and every oracle segment fully recalled in all valid runs but at most one.

6_rw3.rule: RW3_EV3 and ROUTE_EXPERIENCE: semantic success (all expected mandatory present, Mill Street not mandatory) in every valid run, with at least 3 valid runs per fixture, each. Painted Lane is never ROUTE_LEG only.

7_transfers.rule: In every valid run: SOB S2, AG S2 and AG S3 owned by their own assembled segments; SEGMENT_MIXED = 0; TRANSFER_BOUNDARY_MISSED = 0.

10_operational.rule: INVALID_RUN <= 1 of 10 SOB+AG runs (v3: 2/10), with the transport timeout unchanged; operational valid-run rate >= 90%.

decisionRule: All 10 criteria pass -> milestone B is authorized. Any failure -> no automatic v6: stop and review whether the frozen criterion asks for something the domain does not need, or whether a conceptual defect remains.
